reuse.why: Uses the shared linkBankSyncAccount path, extracts the holder lookup from the existing assert and the reset from unlinkAccount, so both old and new paths share them.

duplication.why: The unlink field reset is extracted into clearAccountBankLink and unlinkAccount now calls it; the lookup query lives once in findAccountHoldingBankLink.

placement.why: The takeover branch sits in the single link orchestrator and the lookup in link.ts; clearAccountBankLink could arguably live in link.ts too but sits next to its other caller.

scope.why: Only the flag, the extracted helpers, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Small, well-named helpers with one definition of 'unlinked' and one holder query make the feature easy to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none: goes through linkBankSyncAccount and the link.ts helpers

disguised_duplication.where: none: the reset and the lookup were extracted and shared rather than copied
